summary: Pin sits in dense bush on a steep gully with no track a van could use.

drivers.seclusion: Deep bush on the east, but the back fences of houses are 30 to 40 m west.
drivers.access_and_room: No visible track, clearing or vehicle; the mapped track 61 m away is not visible under the canopy and the cul-de-sac ends at back fences.
drivers.convention: No sign anyone parks or camps here.

sun_shade: Full eucalypt canopy; shaded all day.
